description: This file implements the CloudStoreImplementation class, including its constructor and destructor, and handles registration as a service within the WPEFramework namespace. It interacts with external components via includes and manages an internal service handle and cleanup.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementation
classes.description: Implements the cloud store functionality, manages internal service objects, and registers itself within the plugin system.

methods.name: CloudStoreImplementation()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the internal account store using a factory method and asserts its creation.

methods.name: ~CloudStoreImplementation()
methods.description: Destructor that releases the internal account store if it exists.
